description: ICICI Pru SmartKid 360 is a life insurance plan designed to help parents plan for their child's future milestones, such as education and hobbies, with guaranteed financial support. The plan provides a range of benefits, including MoneyBack payouts, a Special Achievement Award, and a Family Income Benefit, to ensure that the child's dreams are always backed with certainty, even in the unfortunate event of the parent's passing.

features.feature_description: The policyholder can receive one or more MoneyBack benefits, which can be set as a percentage of the Assured Benefit, not exceeding 50% in any policy year.

The policyholder can exercise this feature if the child achieves certain milestones, such as admission to a top university or winning a medal in a sports event, and receive a lump sum payment of 20% of the Guaranteed Maturity Benefit.
The policyholder can opt for a Family Income Benefit, which will provide a regular income to the claimant in the event of the policyholder's death, until the date of maturity.

features.feature_value: Accumulate MoneyBack benefits with loyalty addition
features.feature_description: The policyholder can accumulate MoneyBack benefits with a loyalty addition, which will accrue daily at the prevailing reverse repo rate published by the Reserve Bank of India.
The policyholder can take a loan against the policy, up to 80% of the Surrender Value, at an interest rate that will be reviewed monthly.
